What is Felo?

Multilingual AI search engine built around cross-language retrieval - it searches in several languages simultaneously and returns a unified, cited answer, then can turn that answer into a mind map or presentation.

Best for

Research that spans languages - especially Asian-language sources.

Main features

  • Cross-language simultaneous search
  • cited answers
  • automatic mind-map generation from any answer
  • one-click presentation generation
  • Topic Collections
  • Agent mode for deeper research
  • real-time translation of sources.

Practical use cases

  • Researching a topic across sources in languages you do not read
  • building a visual mind map of a subject
  • generating a first-draft deck from research
  • cross-border market research.

Who is it for?

  • Multilingual researchers, students, international business teams and anyone working across language barriers - particularly strong for Japanese, Chinese and English.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium subscription

Plans described in the source

Free tier with daily limits on Pro Search. Pro around $14.99/mo (roughly $8.33/mo billed annually). Higher tiers and team plans exist. Verify - Felo prices have moved and vary by region.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with basic search and limited Pro Search per day.

Free trial

Short Pro trials have been offered promotionally.

Usage limits to consider

Free tier caps Pro Search queries per day; mind-map and presentation generation also metered on free.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Best cross-language search in the category
  • automatic mind maps are genuinely useful for structuring a topic
  • cheaper than Perplexity Pro
  • presentation export saves real time.

Limitations to consider

  • Smaller and less known than Perplexity
  • English-only research shows less advantage
  • enterprise features and compliance documentation are limited
  • pricing varies by region and is not always clearly documented.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android, Chrome extension

Languages

  • Exceptional multilingual coverage - Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, French, Arabic and more; cross-language retrieval is the core feature

API access

Limited - check current developer documentation

Integrations and exports

  • Browser extension
  • export to Notion, PDF, PowerPoint

Evaluation notes

The strongest reason to choose Felo over Perplexity is genuinely multilingual source material. For English-only work the advantage largely disappears.
